coordinateSystem: three.js right-handed, Y up. x = east, z = south (toward the default camera, which looks north), y = height; floors are at the room levels (see rooms).
rotation: yawDeg = rotation about +Y in degrees (three.js Object3D.rotation.y = yawDeg * PI / 180; the piece's front = local +z faces (sin yaw, cos yaw): 0 = south, 90 = east). rotationEulerDeg is the same as [x, y, z] Euler.
transform: world matrix = compose(position, rotationY(yawDeg), uniform scale) * the lab GLB mesh (the lab files have the transform baked: identity node). The lab GLBs are the ASHLAR source GLBs rescaled to real size (uniform k), baked yaw, re-pivoted to the bottom centre; the optimized GLB in "file" is in the SOURCE frame (about 1 m): use scaleForOptimizedGlb (= scale * labFromOptimized.uniformScale) and add the baked yaw of the lab file (labFromOptimized.horizontalExtents; 180 deg and small squaring yaws are not recoverable). position.y = the floor level at the object (already resolved). Assets with kind "blockout" have no GLB: the lab draws a box shape (assets.<id>.shape, sizeM).
